summary: Every legal input has at most nine decimal digits, which is too narrow to produce an honest runtime scaling verdict.

workload_bound.source_constraint: num is between 1 and 10^9 inclusive and contains no zero digit

replacement_checks.evidence: Each loop iteration removes exactly one decimal digit and performs one constant-time divisibility test, so the loop stops after d iterations.

Regression exhaustively checks every zero-free integer with one through five digits against an independent string-based oracle, then checks representative nine-digit boundary patterns including 999999999.
